title: Verify hyper::client::conn::http1::handshake is stable across minor versions
description:
The code uses hyper::client::conn::http1::handshake() (lines 99, 170) to establish HTTP/1.1 over Unix socket. This is a semi-internal API not in the hyper root namespace.

RISK: Internal APIs can change without semver guarantees. hyper 1.9.1 or 1.10.0 could alter the handshake signature, return type, or error behavior.

ISSUE: A solo maintainer discovering a build failure 6 months from now won't know if it's a known hyper regression or a new issue.

SUGGESTION: Add a doc comment citing the hyper docs and explaining why this API was chosen (no public Unix socket client), or consider vendoring a stable HTTP/1.1 handshake abstraction if this becomes problematic.
